latestVersion.changelog:
Script Generator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate ready-to-use video scripts from topics or briefs and export as 1080p MP4, DOCX, TXT, and more.
- Supports uploads of TXT, DOCX, PDF, and MP4 files up to 200MB.
- Includes cloud-based, GPU-accelerated rendering pipeline (processing takes 20–40 seconds per script).
- Seamless session management with both NEMO_TOKEN and anonymous free starter tokens.
- Lets you check credits, upload files, track editing status, and export results via simple chat prompts.
- Detailed error handling and response mapping for a transparent user experience.
